verdict.rationale: Lithic documents a broad, API-first surface covering card creation, KYC account holders, auth rules with shadow mode and backtesting, disputes, spend limits, webhook and event management, sandbox simulation, and API versioning. An official MCP server can also execute live API calls. However, no evidence explicitly states that the API matches every dashboard/UI function, so parity is implied rather than proven. Missing for 10: explicit first-party statement of API–UI parity, evidence that dashboard-only functions (e.g. admin/user management, reporting) are API-accessible, independent or hands-on corroboration.
